title: Diatomic hydrogen duet
statement:
What electron count should the Lewis drawing assign around each H atom in H₂?

[_]{a}

explanations: One pair is shared between the two atoms.
That counts only each atom’s original contribution.
H has no need for a second pair.
H follows the duet instead of an octet.

hints: Hydrogen has only the first shell.
A single shared pair satisfies its duet.
Both atoms count the shared pair.
solution: Hydrogen has only the first shell. A single shared pair satisfies its duet. Both atoms count the shared pair. One pair is shared between the two atoms.
